components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same lastName and address (i.e. they share a household), and assigns both owners the same householdId. Not stored or returned (see the read-only householdId for the resulting shared identifier).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

The build is green. Here's a summary of what I implemented.

## Change: consolidated duplicate detection into a single `identityKey`

Duplicate detection on `POST /api/owners` was three separate checks (telephone, email, household). They're now one derived key:

```
identityKey = normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId
```

A create is rejected with **409** only when a new owner's *whole* `identityKey` equals an existing owner's.

### What I added
- **`OwnerIdentity`** — single source of truth that builds the key, normalizing each component the same way for a submitted and a stored owner (telephone → E.164 via the existing `OwnerTelephone`, email lower-cased, null → empty).
- **`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique`** — the one duplicate step; computes the new owner's key and compares it against every existing owner's key, throwing `OwnerIdentityDuplicateException`.
- **`OwnerIdentityDuplicateException`** + handler + escalation YAML — responds 409 with `errors: ["identityKey"]` (mirrors the old handlers' shape).
- **`identityKey`** on the OpenAPI `Owner` schema (read-only) and a mapper expression, so it's **returned** in responses. It's purely derived — no new DB column.

### What I changed
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — removed the `checkTelephone`/`checkEmail`/`checkHousehold` steps; `validate` now flows straight to the capacity checks, and a single `checkIdentity` step runs after `assignHousehold` (so `householdId` is known) and before `save`.
- **`AssignHousehold`** — solo owners now get no shared `householdId` (left null) instead of a fresh random UUID; a shared id is minted/stamped only when an owner actually joins an existing household. This is what makes the key behave per spec: two members of the same household with *different* telephones get different keys and are both allowed, while telephone (plus email) drives the collision for independent owners.

### Behaviour change honored
Because telephone is part of the key, same-household members with different telephones are no longer rejected — only an exact full-key match is a duplicate.

### Cleanup
Deleted the three obsolete check functions, their exceptions/handlers, and escalation YAMLs.

### Tests
`./mvnw -o test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `coreRejectsIdentityCollision` passes (two owners sharing a telephone → 409).

One judgment call worth flagging: I made `identityKey` a *derived* value (computed from stored fields) rather than a persisted column — simpler and needs no migration, but it means the returned key always reflects the owner's current field values. If you'd prefer it frozen at creation time, say so and I'll add a column instead.
